faq.refferal2: Will I get rewarded for inviting friends?
faq.refferal_ans2:
Of course! We generously reward those who bring new friends to the project.

You will receive 10% in three levels (5%-3%-2%) from each referral's purchase.
faq.refferal_ans1: Yes, on the Friends page you can invite friends and view referral statistics.
faq.balance3: How long does deposit and withdrawal take?
faq.balance_ans3: Deposits and withdrawals in TON are instant and usually take less than 30 seconds.
faq.balance_ans2:
On the Balance page there's a form to withdraw TON. Enter your wallet and click MAX.

Minimum withdrawal is 0.1 TON.
faq.balance1: How to top up the balance?
faq.balance_ans1: Just go to the Balance page, connect your TON wallet or use the direct MEMO transfer.
faq.what_civilization_ans3: To start, top up your Balance and buy your first Planet.
faq.what_civilization_ans2:
Yes, you earn real TON as rewards.

But keep in mind that CivilizationTon is a game and all top-ups are voluntary donations.
faq.what_civilization_ans: Civilization is a unique P2E game where you can earn rewards in TON.
